policies.name: Plastic Waste Management Roadmap 2018–2030
policies.summary: Bans plastic microbeads, oxo-degradable plastics, and (since 2022) thin plastic bags in major retailers.

newsFeed.headline: Phuket trials deposit-return scheme on tourist beaches
newsFeed.summary: A pilot program pays beachgoers small refunds for returning empty plastic bottles, recovering 8 tonnes in its first month.

wooby.headline: Thailand's tourist beaches are testing pay-to-return-it bottles.
wooby.narrative: Wooby has heard about a fun idea in Thailand: tourists get a small coin back for every bottle they return. Wooby thinks more places should try this!
